problem: Legacy first-mover suggestions for known canonical Twinfield search intents stayed suggested after corrected owner-first inference; skip decisions were still counted as the daily one-blog reservation.
root_cause: Read-only daily reservation selected all matching first-mover recommendations regardless of status. A skipped historical correction could block a later independently proven, non-overlapping candidate on the same day.

observed_evidence.production_canary: 2026-10-29 10:58 UTC 200 ok=true recommendations=0; owner-first for Exact Online and Twinfield

fix: Within the original resolver, reserve the daily new-blog slot only for statuses suggested, accepted or done, never skipped. Preserve the existing published/private candidate metadata and protected publisher authority.
prevention_rule: Rejected/skipped recommendations remain durable audit evidence and must not consume delivery capacity. Never auto-approve or export generated blog drafts.
terminal_rule: Protected exact-head Required/BRAIN/CodeQL, merge to main, authorized Supabase production deploy, exact three-file provider source parity, post-merge internal HTTP canary and durable health readback. No new blog publication claimed.
